csv.name: article CSV
csv.sql:
SELECT title, demo.main.slugify(title) AS slug
FROM read_csv('articles.csv')
ORDER BY id

frames.title: You describe the function.
frames.label: Recorded request · excerpt
frames.code:
Build a TypeScript VGI worker exposing demo.main.slugify(VARCHAR) -> VARCHAR. Lowercase text, transliterate accented Latin characters to ASCII, replace runs of punctuation or whitespace with a single hyphen, and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Preserve SQL NULL.

Run the worker through stock DuckDB 2.0.0 with VGI from query_farm, add repeatable tests, and leave vgi-worker.json with the actual launch argv and catalog demo in this project.

Use published dependencies and pin them.
frames.footer: The vgi-worker skill is installed. The developer chose TypeScript for this run.
